metadata.title: Recall‑Driven Recovery

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing recovery actions when recall, safety withdrawal, or authority-driven removal from service has occurred.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Resilience, recall handling, halt, isolation, decommissioning, and authority-driven recovery suppression.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining recall as an overriding constraint on recovery and resumption.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines recall status as trust-relevant resilience data that suppresses restore and resume actions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Continuity and recovery controls are overridden by recall and safety withdrawal conditions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that authority and context may revoke trust and operation eligibility.

metadata.remarks: Recall‑Driven Recovery defines how recovery and resilience actions are constrained when a system, device, or component is subject to recall or authority-driven withdrawal. Restore and resume are explicitly prohibited while recall conditions are in effect.

components.title: Recall Authority Signal
components.description: Recognition of authoritative recall, safety withdrawal, or mandated removal from service.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Resilience planning incorporates authoritative withdrawal and recall conditions.

components.title: Restore Suppression on Recall
components.description: Explicit suppression of restore, rollback, or replay actions for recalled entities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery actions are prohibited when recall conditions exist.

components.title: Mandatory Halt or Isolation
components.description: Enforced halt or isolation of recalled systems to prevent further operation.

components.title: Recall‑Driven Decommissioning
components.description: Permanent removal from service when recall conditions are irreversible or unresolved.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuity arrangements do not permit operation of withdrawn systems.

components.title: Recall Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what recall handling does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Availability of backups does not permit restoration of recalled entities.
